feeds.title: Irishwonder's Black Hat SEO Blog
feeds.description: IrishWonder believes in using the right tools for the job rather than sticking to whatever ideology. He works with purely whitehat sites as well as grey and blackhat, achieving success in every niche he approaches. Follow his blog about blackhat, general SEO issues and other things related to life on the web.

feeds.title: SEO Hacker » Black Hat SEO
feeds.description: Sean Si is the author and Editor-In-Chief of SEO Hacker. The SEO Hacker Blog is all about providing the world with the latest information in the SEO industry. In the Black Hat SEO section get to know everything from advice to tips and tricks to lessons and tutorials, we are driven in teaching the rising necessity of SEO to the internet-savvy community of the Philippines and the rest of the world.
